ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_gevonden.des: &6Fossils&r lie in old digs, the fossil mine of the Barbecuether, the abandoned guh mine and at the cave paintings under the wool. Find one!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_broedmachine: Put a fossil and 16 cheese nibbles in the &dFossil Hatchery&r and give it &b20 chonk power&r.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_uitgebroed.d: After a whole Minecraft day of hatching a baby ancient guh crawls out of the egg. It is yours right away!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_mammoet.desc: A &dMammoth Guh&r does its chores twice as fast, and cuddling gives wool.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_tguh.title: T-Guh
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_tguh.desc: Give a &dT-Guh&r the chore &eWatch&r: it spots monsters coming from very far away. Rawr, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_pteroguh.des: A &dPteroguh&r in a guh house flies goods to chests far around the house.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_stokstaartje: Take an &dAncient Meerkat Guh&r along: it stands up and points out rare guhs nearby.
